code_search_screen.rule: Include a hit file when its tests demonstrate an exploit succeeding against a Solana program (titles or names say exploit/attack/PoC/bug and the test asserts the attack's effect). Exclude: realism-gate itself; tool, agent, prompt, template or fuzzer source; regression or security suites where the attack is expected to fail; feature suites; course data; non-Solana code. Only hit files are taken; sibling files of an included repository are not searched.
